svg.title: Garage (tp::garage): upgrades as parameter changes, the career's money

g.text: Garage (tp::garage): upgrades as parameter changes, the career's money
+validate(const Catalogue&, const vehicle::Params&, const rules::ClassRules&) : optional<ParamError>
+equipped(const vehicle::Params&, const Catalogue&, const Career&) : optional<vehicle::Params>
level 0 of every upgrade is the tractor the player starts with;
each level sets its part's value outright, so parts never interact
and validate() checks each level with the others at their top.
The top levels reach the class's limits (NTTO standard 3.5 t:
85 hp at the PTO, 3500 kg, the hitch at 0.5 m)
